message: Fixes live revocation not kicking an already-running session. The client now latches the verified hardware-bound GEN2 License ID before launching the protected core and keeps that exact entitlement bound for the full session, even if the core later hides or moves license.dat or stops exposing its local status endpoint. The signed GitHub revocation list is polled every 5 seconds with cache-busting, and a confirmed revoke immediately persists the revoke lock and terminates the running game/browser session without requiring a restart. Restart lockout and automatic Restore of the same hardware-bound activation remain enabled.
